stemMd: Which statement is equivalent to “No alloy in this batch contains lead”?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Some alloys in the batch contain lead.

options.label: D
options.textMd: All lead-free alloys are in this batch.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every alloy in this batch is lead-free.

explanationMd: Saying no member has a property is equivalent to saying every member lacks it. The scope remains this batch. Nothing is claimed about alloys elsewhere or about the number of alloys in the batch.

distractorRationale.d: This reverses the relationship and expands its scope.
distractorRationale.c: This is much broader than the batch-specific claim.
distractorRationale.b: The original does not require the batch to be empty.
